newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Rashid seen in 9.0 rgt bid for bank.
newsitem.headline: Rashid seen in 9.0 rgt bid for bank.

text.p: Malaysian stockbroker Rashid Hussain Bhd (RHB) is said to be offering 9.0 ringgit a share to buy Malayan Banking Bhd's (Maybank) stake in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd, a report from a brokerage said on Wednesday.
At that price, the Kwong Yik equity interest would cost a total of 2.9 billion ringgit, a research report from HLG Securities said.
Maybank owns a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik and is widely speculated to be in negotiations to sell it to RHB.
All four stocks have been suspended since Monday for news announcements.
Officials at RHB, Maybank and DCB on Wednesday declined to comment on the speculated deals, saying statements will likely be released by the end of the week.
Quoting sources, the report said RHB is then expected to sell Kwong Yik's operations along with its own securities arm to DCB Holdings Bhd, of which RHB owns 20.4 percent.
"DCB will most probably fund its purchase through the issue of new shares to RHB enabling it to become a subsidiary of RHB," the HLG report said.
Kwong Yik, on the sale of its operations, "will become a shell listing with cash which it will use to acquire RHB's property assets," the report said.
